name: Wit of the Shifting Dune
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You recall the effect of your henge on the desert, allowing you to shift the ground beneath your enemies. Each enemy in the burst takes 1d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level, and is knocked prone.

Until the end of combat, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls against prone targets.
